name: @cloudsforge/indexer
description: The multi-chain indexer. One normalised schema, a worker per chain family, checkpointing, reorg recovery and provider failover. Replaces balance-probing (AD-07).
_runtimeDependencies: @cloudsforge/contracts-events are consumed as file:/link: paths because they are not published
yet. Once AD-02 lands they become registry versions and these paths — plus the two named build
contexts in the Dockerfile and the extra checkouts in CI — are deleted. Nothing else in this
@cloudsforge/contracts-events is `link:` rather than `file:` for the reason ledger, wallet and
settlement use link: for it: it is source consumed by tsc, not a package to be copied into this
tree, and the Dockerfile already carries the whole contracts checkout as a named build context.
The runtime packages take a caret range on publish ('^1.0.0'). contracts-chain does NOT:
it takes an EXACT pin ('1.0.0'), because wallet, settlement, custody and indexer must agree
byte-for-byte on confirmation depths and amount maths. A caret there is money credited at
the wrong depth — see the package's own header.
tsx is a runtime dependency for the same reason: the unpublished packages resolve to their
TypeScript sources. On publish their publishConfig points at dist/, tsx moves to
devDependencies, and the image runs 'node dist/index.js'.
